title: The Architecture of Autonomous Agents: ReAct, Tool Calling & Self-Correction

visual.metaphor: Glass bell jar oracle to mechanical limbs, 3-gear ReAct clockwork loop, hydraulic JSON schema stamping press, sandboxed environment execution conveyor, Reflexion self-correcting mirror, and multi-agent swarm constellation

beats.description: Magi in antique lab observing a glowing neural brain trapped in a glass bell jar; quotes thermodynamics as small fire starts, but cannot pour water until Magi unlocks it
Magi pulls a brass lever turning three enormous interlocking golden gears: Thought (internal scratchpad), Action (tool choice), and Observation (real-world feedback)
Unstructured neural tokens enter a precision blueprint table; hydraulic brass stamping press clamps fuzzy thoughts into valid JSON function calls with strict schemas
Control passes to the execution harness; automated robotic arms execute bash commands, query SQL databases, and navigate live browsers, returning text observations
Tool fails with a red buzzer; Magi inspects the glowing Reflexion mirror, analyzes the stack trace, backtracks one step, adjusts the code, and passes the test
Magi coordinates four specialized subagent drones (Researcher, Coder, Tester, Reviewer) on a shared luminous message board, synthesizing the future of work

labels.text: EPISODE 08: THE ARCHITECTURE OF AUTONOMOUS AGENTS
